September 30, 1931          Sofia, Bulgaria
Bulgaria 5-1 Turkey
Scorers: Mihail Lozanov 4', Arsen Panchev (2), Velcio Stoianov 56',
Arsen Peshev (B); Hakki Yeten 31' (T)
Bulgaria: Todor Dermonski, Gorchev, Todor Michtalov,
Gabrovski, Dimitar Baikutchev, Ljubomir Anghelov, Velcio

Çizer, Hakki Yeten, Fikret Arican, Rebbi Erkal
